instructions: Which single research topic fits this AI paper best? Judge by the main contribution described in the title and abstract, not by a method it only uses along the way.

topics.name: LLM reasoning
topics.criterion: Reasoning in language models: chain of thought, math and logic problem solving, test-time compute, planning done by the model itself.

topics.name: Agents and tool use
topics.criterion: LLM agents that act over many steps: tool calling, web or computer use, memory, multi-agent systems, agent frameworks.

topics.name: LLM training
topics.criterion: How language models are trained: pretraining data, fine-tuning, RLHF and preference optimization, scaling laws, new model architectures.

topics.name: Efficiency and systems
topics.criterion: Making models cheaper or faster: quantization, pruning, distillation, KV cache, serving systems, hardware, edge deployment.

topics.name: Retrieval and RAG
topics.criterion: Retrieval augmented generation, search and ranking, embeddings for retrieval, knowledge graphs, recommender systems.

topics.name: NLP and language
topics.criterion: Classic language tasks and linguistics: translation, summarization, information extraction, sentiment, multilingual and low-resource languages.

topics.name: Benchmarks and evaluation
topics.criterion: The main contribution is a benchmark, a dataset, or an evaluation method for AI models, including LLM-as-judge studies.

topics.name: Safety and security
topics.criterion: Attacks and defenses: jailbreaks, prompt injection, adversarial examples, backdoors, privacy leaks, hallucination detection, watermarking, deepfake detection.

topics.name: AI and society
topics.criterion: Fairness and bias, ethics, policy and governance, human-AI interaction, education, studies of how people use AI.

topics.name: Interpretability
topics.criterion: Explaining what happens inside a model: mechanistic interpretability, probing, feature attribution, sparse autoencoders, explainable AI methods.

topics.name: Visual recognition
topics.criterion: Perception in 2D images: classification, detection, segmentation, tracking, pose, OCR, remote sensing and aerial imagery.

topics.name: Image and video generation
topics.criterion: Generating or editing images and video: diffusion and flow models, text-to-image, text-to-video, style transfer, restoration and super-resolution.

topics.name: 3D vision
topics.criterion: 3D reconstruction and scene representation: NeRF, Gaussian splatting, depth, point clouds, SLAM, avatars and human body capture.

topics.name: Multimodal models
topics.criterion: Vision-language models and models over several modalities: visual question answering, video understanding with language, multimodal LLMs.

topics.name: Medicine and biology
topics.criterion: Healthcare and life science applications: medical imaging, clinical text, diagnosis, drug discovery, proteins, genomics.

topics.name: Robotics
topics.criterion: Physical robots and embodied agents: manipulation, locomotion, navigation, vision-language-action models, sim-to-real.

topics.name: Autonomous driving
topics.criterion: Self-driving and traffic: driving perception and planning, trajectory prediction, driving simulation, intelligent transportation.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning
topics.criterion: Reinforcement learning as the subject itself: policy optimization, offline RL, bandits, exploration, control, games. Not RL used only to fine-tune an LLM.

topics.name: Theory and optimization
topics.criterion: Mathematical results about learning: generalization bounds, optimization algorithms and convergence, statistical learning theory, probabilistic inference.

topics.name: Graphs and tabular
topics.criterion: Learning on structured data: graph neural networks, tabular models, anomaly detection, causal discovery, classic machine learning on tables.

topics.name: Time series
topics.criterion: Forecasting and sequence sensing: time series models, spatio-temporal prediction, sensor and wearable signals, EEG and other physiological signals.

topics.name: AI for science
topics.criterion: Physical science and engineering: physics-informed networks, PDE solvers, chemistry, materials, climate and weather, quantum computing.

topics.name: Speech and audio
topics.criterion: Sound: speech recognition, text to speech, speaker tasks, audio understanding, music generation and analysis.

topics.name: Code
topics.criterion: Code generation, program repair, software engineering with LLMs, formal verification, program synthesis.
